    assert simplify("2/3", "3/2") == True      # 6/6 = 1
    assert simplify("3/1", "4/1") == True      # 12/1 = 12
    assert simplify("-1/2", "2/1") == True     # -2/2 = -1 (negatives work)

    try:

    except ValueError:
        pass
